target.name: 3kWp flat roof installation, multi-Si, on roof

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tab. 5.5.1 'Unit process data of different PV mounting systems', column 'flat roof construction, on roof' [RER], per 1 m2 of panel area. One 3 kWp installation is taken as 20.7 m2 of module area (3 kWp at a standard module power density), so one m2 of basis is 1/20.7 of a target unit.; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: 2015 - LCI and LCA photovoltaic systems - Frischknecht.pdf

gaps_reported_by_model: The excerpt documents only the MOUNTING STRUCTURE. A '3 kWp ... installation' dataset also contains the photovoltaic panel/laminate (Tab. 5.1.8.2.x, pages outside this range), the inverter (Tab. 5.6.1.3/5.6.1.4) and the electric installation, none of which can be read here.

The table is per m2 of panel area; the excerpt gives no module efficiency, so the m2 per 3 kWp had to be taken from a standard module power density. Every amount carries that scaling uncertainty (the bounds correspond to roughly 15 to 27 m2 per 3 kWp).
No direct emissions and no land use for the roof variants (the Transformation and Occupation rows are '-' for every roof column; they apply only to open-ground constructions).
The table is European (RER) data while the BAFU dataset is [APAC] resp. [CH].
skipped_items: transport, van <3.5t: no dataset chosen (No freight service for a van under 3.5 t is offered: candidate 0 is the vehicle itself (unit) and candidate 2 its maintenance, while the remaining candidates are barge, rail and aircraft freight. Mapping a van transport to a barge or a train would be the wrong mode, so the line is reported as missing.)
